description: This bar chart, from the paper "MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs," illustrates the F1 Score (%) achieved by different variants of the MADLLM model across six distinct datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, ordered from left to right as SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis, labeled "F1 Score (%)", is scaled linearly from 60 to 100, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 10. For each dataset, three bars are grouped side-by-side, representing different model configurations: a green bar for "MADLLM", a blue bar for "MADLLM w/o prompt pool", a purple bar for "MADLLM w/o feature embedding", and an orange bar for "MADLLM w/o skip embedding". The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the datasets. Visually, the green bars (MADLLM) are generally the tallest, indicating the highest F1 scores, while the purple and orange bars (MADLLM w/o feature embedding and MADLLM w/o skip embedding) are consistently shorter, indicating lower performance. For example, in the SMD dataset, the green bar reaches approximately 95%, while the purple bar is around 92% and the orange bar is about 94%. In the WADI dataset, the green bar is approximately 90%, the purple bar is around 80%, and the orange bar is about 85%. The chart does not show any bars with special visual emphasis such as shading or bolding.
